text:
Assistant A is better. It correctly describes a solar thermal system: collectors that absorb heat (flat-plate or evacuated tube), a heat exchanger, a storage tank, a circulation pump and a controller. It also covers sensible considerations (location, climate, sizing, orientation, backup) and gives a coherent five-step workflow.

Assistant B describes photovoltaic panels, an inverter and a battery, which are not needed for a solar water heating system. It also lists every component twice, and its workflow is generic and shallow.

[[A]]
